search_questions: Which computational mechanisms are proposed as indicators of conscious access?
Which markers distinguish self-modeling from language-based imitation?

inclusion_rules: Prefer primary papers or authoritative reviews.
Record DOI or stable identifier when available.
Separate demonstrated computational behavior from theoretical interpretation.
Do not infer sentience from anthropomorphic reports alone.
